_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. Recommended Pineton configuration: a single-seat Mayor counted by IRV plus a four-seat Council counted by STV (single transferable vote). The Mayor winner is excluded from the Council count via excludeWinnersFrom. Office and candidate keys are arbitrary identifiers; no office name is hardcoded anywhere in the plugin. STV uses ranked ballots, exactly like IRV, but fills multiple seats; it does not use maxSelections. Copy this file into plugins/ModNVote/definitions and import it with /modnvote config <pollId> import pineton-mayor-stv-council.json after creating a LINKED_OFFICES poll, then validate-definition, ready and open it for voting.
